data.approach: Read the supplied inputs, do the work, and check every completion criterion.

planning.title: Work plan
planning.boundary: Send asks your selected assistant for a plan. Saving a plan starts no work and grants nothing.
planning.saved: Plan saved. Review or edit the assignments before running them.

steps.label: Plan it differently
steps.message: Read the current Agent Desk task context and plan the work differently. Say what changes and why a separate worker earns its cost for each assignment, then save the replacement with plan_work and a fresh expectedRevision. Do not change the criteria. What I want changed:

working.title: Task work
working.boundary: Send starts work through your selected assistant and existing approvals. Saving an attempt never accepts it.
working.saved: Attempt saved. Check each criterion before accepting the result.

steps.label: Try a different approach
steps.message: Try a materially different approach on the same frozen task and plan. State what changed and why it may help; keep the earlier failed evidence. Do the work through permitted tools, then save a separate propose_attempt with a fresh expectedRevision. Do not change the criteria. My approach:

steps.label: Combine supported findings
steps.message: Read the current Agent Desk task context. Compare the saved attempts and their worker reports against the same frozen criteria. Combine only findings supported by actual evidence, do the remaining checks with permitted tools, keep failures and uncertainty visible, and save a new unreviewed propose_attempt. Do not change permissions, instructions or criteria.
